messages.text: I would like to know when I'm getting my Thor P2, I was given a DC08.

I can look that up for you. What's your order number? Send it with one detail from the order, like the name it ships to, the postcode ····email, and I'll check where your Thor P2 is.

Also, when you say you were given a DC08, do you mean a DC08 arrived in the box instead of the Thor P2? Or was it offered to you as a swap?
We've chatted before.ORDER Shop····

Thanks. To pull up Shop···· I need one detail that matches the order. That can be the name it ships to, the postcode, the last four digits of the phone number or the email. Send whichever is easiest and I'll check where your Thor P2 is.

Handed to the team · Probable mispick at the warehouse. A replacement shipment and return of the DC08

Found it, Neil. Your order shipped by UPS on November 8 from our Tennessee warehouse and shows as delivered. Our records say the box held a Thor P2, so if a DC08 came out of it, the warehouse packed the wrong unit. I'm sorry, especially after how long you'd already been waiting.

I've passed this to the team. They're offline right now and will pick it up today at 10am ET. Their answer will come to your email.

To help them sort it faster, can you send a photo of the DC08 and the shipping label on the box? Please keep the DC08 as it arrived until then.
I ordered a Thor that was in stock and then it was delayed, then it was delayed again, then a DC08 arrived, but I still haven't received the Thor I ordered
Used the order-swap skill

Neil, you're right, and I'm sorry. You ordered an in-stock Thor P2 on September 8. It was due to ship October 3, it slipped twice, and when a box finally came on November 8 it held the wrong miner. That's on us, not you.

Our records show that shipment as a Thor P2, so the warehouse clearly packed the wrong unit. Georges, the owner, now has your case personally, including the long wait.

The photo of the DC08 and the box label will speed things up. Until then, keep the DC08 as it arrived.
I called him this week and left a message. He did not reply, I have sent that shipping label information to you before

I'm sorry, Neil. You shouldn't have to send the same thing twice, and you shouldn't be left without a call back. You don't need to send the label again.

Georges has your case personally. It covers the whole history: the September 8 order, both delays, and the DC08 that arrived on November 8 instead of your Thor P2.

One thing that will help him act right away: do you still want the Thor P2 itself sent to you in (address hidden), or would you rather have something else?
I still want the Thor, I was considering other asics but after not receiving the right one since September, I'm starting to doubt I'll get the asic when it's still cold outside.
Used the order-swap skill

That's fair, Neil. After waiting since September, you'd want it running before the cold is gone.

There's some good news. I just checked, and Thor P2 units are on the shelf right now at our Tennessee warehouse, where your last box came from. Getting your Thor to you doesn't depend on new stock arriving. It only needs Georges to send it out.

I've noted that you want the Thor P2 itself. He has your full history with that.

Is the DC08 still sealed, or did you open or plug it in?
I have to go to work. I look forward to you message.

Understood, Neil. Have a good day at work.

You don't need to stay here. Georges's reply about getting your Thor P2 sent will come to the email on your order, so check your spam folder too. A copy of this whole chat will also come to that email once we're done, and you can reply to it any time to reach us.

When you get a moment, let us know whether the DC08 is still sealed. That helps with sorting out its return.
It was a big a big hammer asic, I didn't realize until I powered it on.
Looked something up in Shopify

I've written up for Georges that Neil got a DC08 and opened it, along with his full history and his request for the Thor P2 itself.

Thanks, Neil, that helps. It makes sense you only found out once it was running, since the outside of the box wouldn't have told you. I've noted on your order that it was a big Hammer miner and that you've already powered it on, so Georges has the full picture.

Please unplug it and keep it with its box and packaging if you still have them. That keeps the return simple.

His reply will come to your email. Have a good shift.
